Name: Hide Chest Color Picker After Close
Author: trashcan9
Description:
Small mod that closes the color picked upon closing a chest inventory so that you don't have to manually toggle it off.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
